vulkanmod.options.blockEntityCulling.too: Skips each block entity outside the view, instead of drawing every block entity of a partly visible chunk section.
vulkanmod.options.retainedChests.tooltip: Keeps the geometry of block entities at rest (closed chests and shulker boxes, decorated pots, skulls, sign text) on the GPU across frames instead of rebuilding it every frame.
vulkanmod.options.instancedModels.toolti: Draws closed enchanting table books and armor stands posed alike as GPU instances.
vulkanmod.options.modelBackFaceCulling.t: Leaves out entity and block entity faces, and sign text, that face away from the camera on the CPU. The GPU would discard them anyway.
vulkanmod.options.particleSpawnLimit.too: Drops new particles when there are already as many as the game can show, instead of queueing them to be discarded later.
vulkanmod.options.terrainFaceCulling.too: Skips the block faces of a chunk section that all point away from the camera, which the GPU would discard anyway. Changing it reloads the chunks.
vulkanmod.options.compressedTerrain.tool: Stores solid and cutout block vertices in 20 instead of 28 bytes, so the GPU reads less memory per frame. Changing it reloads the chunks.
vulkanmod.options.sectionLightCache.tool: Builds chunks faster: smooth lighting reads each block's light once per chunk section instead of through a small cache that keeps forgetting it. The lighting is identical.
vulkanmod.options.sectionStateCache.tool: Builds chunks faster: the blocks around each block (for hidden faces and smooth lighting) are read from a flat array instead of the chunk's compressed storage. The chunks look identical.
vulkanmod.options.biomeBlendCache.toolti: Builds chunks faster: biome colour blending (grass, leaves, water) looks up each column's biome once per chunk section instead of once for every block around it. The colours are identical.
vulkanmod.options.skipIdleTicks.tooltip: Skips ticking closed chests and signs nobody is editing, whose ticks do nothing.
vulkanmod.options.reuseEntityStates.tool: Armor stands reuse their render state from the previous frame instead of creating a new one every frame.
vulkanmod.options.blockModelMeshCache.to: Item frames, block displays, minecarts and endermen reuse the quads of their block models instead of building them again every frame.
vulkanmod.options.hashedDrawLookup.toolt: Finds the draw an entity's or item's geometry goes into with a hash lookup instead of searching all of the frame's draws.
